title: Plasma USD Vault (Veda BoringVault + LayerZeroTeller) — solver-gated exit and cross-chain NAV
closed_reasons: bulkWithdraw is solver-only: authority.canCall(0x1111, teller, bulkWithdraw) = false and a fresh caller reverts UNAUTHORIZED
vault.exit/enter/manage are not public (canCall false); only the teller/router can call them
the batch-redeem router 0x111c... has canCall(0x1111, router, 0x5ff8a71f) = false
the accountant rate 1.048796 equals the GLOBAL NAV 1.048826 (2.9 bps = interest since the last update), so the pass-2 2.24% 'stale NAV' is a cross-chain aggregation artifact
the $699k is the Ethereum mirror shares' claim, exactly offset by the Plasma excess; it is not unprivileged yield
the only public markets are two DEX pools with $49.6k combined depth at 15-28% discounts; the market-implied conditional is ~$2.25k
key_facts: global supply 30,395,919.317435 and global assets $31,880,043.39 -> global NAV 1.048826 vs accountant rate 1.048796 (2.9 bps = ~7h of Aave interest; last update 2026-10-19 16:40:47 UTC)
the 2.24% gap is exactly the Ethereum share of global supply: 691,899.07 / 30,395,919.32 = 2.276%; $699,078.75 is the Ethereum claim net of its $26.6k local assets, matched by the Plasma excess
deposit is public (auth passes, only TRANSFER_FROM_FAILED); bridge is public (auth passes, underflow on zero shares); bulkWithdraw reverts UNAUTHORIZED

LZ peers: Plasma eid 30101 <-> Ethereum eid 30383, both (allowFrom=true, allowTo=true, gas=200000); bridge is heavily used (5,232 MessageSent from Ethereum; 201 of the last 300 Ethereum teller txs are bridge calls)
solver exit is active: 122 Plasma BulkWithdraw events (4,221,663 shares); latest at block 35,494,152 redeemed 955,031.43424 shares (~$1.001M) via router 0x111c973C84b6f400A8B6b74675079A9ddA41F5dc
Ethereum mirror is locally undercollateralized: $26,582 assets for $725,661 of claims (3.7% coverage); top holder 0x3938A7D74f692A8A662Fb17d6081e3a494de22e6 holds 500,000 shares (72.3%)
secondary markets: Ethereum Uniswap V4 USDC/PlasmaUSD pool $45,506 reserve at $0.886224 (15.5% discount); Plasma Balancer V3 USDT0/PlasmaUSD $4,097 at $0.752438 (28.3% discount); both zero 24h volume
market-implied conditional if a public exit at 1.0488 opens: ~$1,674 (ETH V4) + ~$579 (Plasma Balancer) = ~$2,253 gross, not $699k
accountantState: exchangeRate 1,048,796; lastUpdateTimestamp 1,792,428,047; minimumUpdateDelay 21,600s; updateExchangeRate is requiresAuth (canCall false for a fresh address)
caveats: The aToken is rebasing; the global NAV drifts ~0.003% per 6-7h between rate updates. The rate is keeper-set, not computed on-chain
The 'global NAV' is an independent balance-sheet check; the accountant's own formula uses the stored exchangeRate
The DEX prices are spot prices with zero 24h volume; $2.25k is a depth/fee bound, not a guaranteed profit
The $699k P/S values overlap: P is a privileged rate-update/write-off value; S is the same gap if the LZ bridge is disabled. Neither is E-U
The Ethereum top-holder balance is from Blockscout and may change; the $725.7k claim uses the global rate 1.048796
No mainnet transaction was sent; all attacker calls are eth_call/fork simulations
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 from the Plasma USD Vault: both exits are solver-gated and the accountant rate (1.048796) is the correct global NAV (1.048826); the pass-2 $699k 'stale NAV' is the Ethereum mirror's 2.276% share of global supply, a privileged/cross-chain buffer, not unprivileged yield, with only ~$2.25k market-implied conditional value if a public exit opens.
